meta.title: Splitting is refused once an award is submitted — with a misleading message
gaps: The request body for creating one lot is not defined, so the lot payload and quoted trade product cannot be expressed without inventing fields.
No available read-back field directly verifies that no lot was created.
The expected application wording says an award proposal is already submitted, but the available expected message is the misleading auction-created message.
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (rfx_project_enabled) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the trade create new lot request, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot edit rfq once the auction is created.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Splitting is refused once an award is submitted — with a misleading message

expected.message: You cannot edit rfq once the auction is created.
